text:
#!name=虎扑
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = games.mobileapi.hupu.com, du.hupucdn.com, i*.hoopchina.com.cn, goblin.hupu.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/games\.mobileapi\.hupu\.com\/.+?\/(interfaceAdMonitor|interfaceAd)\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/games\.mobileapi\.hupu\.com\/.+?\/(search|interfaceAdMonitor|status|hupuBbsPm)\/(hotkey|init|hupuBbsPm)\./i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/games\.mobileapi\.hupu\.com\/.+?\/status\/init/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/games\.mobileapi\.hupu\.com\/\d\/(?:\d\.){2}\d\/status\/init/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/du\.hupucdn\.com\/\w+h\d{4}/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/i\d\.hoopchina\.com\.cn\/blogfile\/\/d+\/\/d+\/BbsImg\.(?<=(big.(png|jpg)))$/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/goblin\.hupu\.com\/.+\/interfaceAd\/getOther/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/i1\.hoopchina\.com\.cn\/blogfile\/.+_\d{3}x\d{4}/i then reject_img(200)
